description: This file defines the SoundRecorder class, which provides functionalities for recording audio input from the microphone and playing back the recorded audio. It manages recording and playback asynchronously, handles file I/O, and interacts with Android's audio APIs.

classes.name: SoundRecorder
classes.description: A helper class to manage audio recording from MIC to internal storage and playback of the recorded audio.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Begins recording audio input from the microphone asynchronously.

methods.name: startPlay
methods.description: Starts playback of the recorded audio file asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Releases resources used by AudioTrack and AudioRecord.
